content: विपरीत {%a.%} .²1 Reversed, inverted. .²2 Contrary, opposite, reverse, inverse; राज्येन किं तद्विपरीतवृत्तेः <ls>R. 2. 53</ls>. .²3 Wrong, contrary to rule. .²4 False, untrue; विपरीतार्थविदो हि योषितः <ls>Bv. 2. 177</ls>. .²5 Unfavourable, adverse. .²6 Cross, acting in an opposite manner; विपरीतश्च वृद्धश्च विषयैश्च प्रधर्षितः <ls>Rām. 2. 21. 3</ls>. .²7 Disagreeable, inauspicious. .{@-तः@} A particular mode of sexual enjoyment. .{@-ता@} .²1 An unchaste or faithless wife. .²2 A perverse woman.
